description: The bar chart illustrates ratios (in percent) for three models—Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT—across three knowledge domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis contains the categorical domains in left-to-right order “Movies,” “Songs,” and “Basketball,” while the vertical axis is labeled “Ratio (%)” and uses a linear scale spanning roughly 50 to 90 with evenly spaced tick marks at 50, 60, 70, 80, and 90. Each category shows a grouped set of three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend at the top: Llama3 in blue, Qwen2 in reddish-brown, and ChatGPT in olive/gold. In Movies, the blue Llama3 bar is near 90%, the reddish-brown Qwen2 bar is about 90%, and the olive ChatGPT bar is around 73%. In Songs, Llama3 is approximately 84%, Qwen2 is about 90%, and ChatGPT is near 62–63%. In Basketball, Llama3 is around 66–67%, Qwen2 is about 57–58%, and ChatGPT is around 61–62%. The bars are not visually sorted by height within categories, and there are no special annotations or emphasized bars beyond the color-coding and legend.
